results.note: De vitiis et virtutibus (On Vices and Virtues) — Latin text available on Wikisource but no English translation found. Searched CCEL, Roger Pearse, FOTC series, and academic databases without result.

Epistolae (Letters) — Individual letters have English translations via Epistolae project (Columbia, selected medieval letters to/from women). Standard scholarly edition is MGH Dümmler (Latin 1899), but no complete English translation of the full Migne collection found.

Epitaphia (Epitaphs) — Some epitaphs and epigrammatic poetry by Rabanus may be included in Helen Waddell's Mediaeval Latin Lyrics (which has a Rabanus section with PD translations), but no specific confirmation that the complete Migne section is translated.

Hymni — Multiple PD English translations exist, especially Veni Creator Spiritus (Edward Caswall 1849, Lyra Catholica; also in Hymnary.org and The Hymnal 1982). Additional hymns like Christe, sanctorum decus Angelorum (Christ, the fair glory) appear in The Hymnal 1982 with Vaughan Williams harmonization.

Liber de sacris ordinibus (Book on Sacred Orders) — No English translation found. Work mentioned in Wikipedia biographical sources but no published English translation located despite searches through medieval translation series.
Liber poenitentium (Book of Penance) — Latin text available on Wikisource but no English translation found. Searched academic databases and medieval penitential literature resources without result.

Praefatio in De quaestionibus canonum poenitentialium (Preface to Canonical Questions on Penance) — No English translation found. Work is in Migne PL but translation evidence not located despite targeted searches.

Excerptio de Arte grammatica Prisciani (Excerpt on Priscian's Grammar) — 9th-century grammatical compendium available in Latin at Documenta Catholica Omnia and academic repositories, but no English translation found in published sources.
